attribute.summary: Marks a method as a Remote Procedure Call that can be invoked on other peers with CometEngine::Network::Multiplayer::Rpc / RpcId. Takes any number of the following tokens, in any order: "authority" (default, only the entity's authority may invoke it) or "any_peer" (any peer may invoke it); "call_remote" (default, does not run on the caller) or "call_local" (also runs on the caller); "reliable" (default), "unreliable" or "unreliable_ordered"; and a number for the transfer channel (default 0).
attribute.param: "authority" (default) so only the entity's authority may invoke it, or "any_peer" so any peer may (validate the sender inside the method).
"call_remote" (default) to skip the caller, or "call_local" to also run the method on the caller.
The transfer channel to send the call on.

attribute.name: Replicate
attribute.summary: Continuously keeps a script variable in sync from the entity's multiplayer authority to every other peer, and also includes it in the spawn message. Requires a MultiplayerSynchronizer on the same entity, which auto-discovers the field at runtime. Supported types: numbers, bool, string, Vector2/Vector3/Vector4, Color and resource references.
attribute.param: How the value is synced: "on_change" (default, reliable, sent only when the value changes), "always" (every frame, unreliable, for fast-changing values like position) or "never" (not synced continuously, only sent inside the spawn message).

attribute.name: ReplicateOnSpawn
attribute.summary: Sends this field's value once, inside the spawn message, so freshly spawned copies and late joiners start with the correct initial value (a bullet's direction, a team colour, a weapon id...). Requires a MultiplayerSynchronizer on the same entity, which auto-discovers the field at runtime. Supported types: numbers, bool, string, Vector2/Vector3/Vector4, Color and resource references.
